measurementCorrection.problem: schemaVersion 1 checked canvas visibility inside drawArrays, before YADIF made the canvas visible immediately after drawArrays returned, so it could skip the revealing draw
measurementCorrection.fix: retain the direct draw timestamp and verify computed visibility in a microtask after the YADIF call stack completes
measurementCorrection.supersedes: schemaVersion 1 measurements published in commit cdf5651 and the unpublished intermediate v2 measurement

conditions.transport: LAN direct to isolated local KonomiTV
conditions.playback: recorded MPEG-2 TS Original, YADIF double-rate, true fullscreen
conditions.warmup: first two distant seeks in each fresh tab excluded
conditions.tabRule: zero matching pages before each block; one foreground page during the block; playback stopped and page closed after every block
conditions.visibleFrame: first direct YADIF canvas draw after a new post-seek rVFC, counted when computed visibility is visible and opacity is nonzero after the draw call stack

implementation.commonBase: tsukumijima/mpeg2toh264 52a3db5 plus YADIF queue successor source 26484fd and seek timing instrumentation
implementation.fixedDifference: remove the first-fragment write that paired the range start byte with the later first-fragment media timestamp

interpretation: The erroneous overwrite made interpolation select an older GOP at 12 of 20 target positions.
All fixed first fragments remained at or before the user target.

The first-fragment target-paired interval includes zero, while browser presentation and visible canvas intervals do not; reduced client-side decode and discard explains most of the visible improvement.
The corrected visible-canvas measurement still exceeds the stable 250 ms target, so decoder presentation and YADIF scheduling remain separate work.

excludedRuns.reason: the first revealing draw could occur before visibility changed or before the separate observer callback set its flag; retained in Git history but superseded for visible-canvas latency
the first intercepted direct draw could belong to the old queue
one draw was captured while the canvas was hidden
